The magnetometer the magnetic field needs was not found.
Move your phone in a figure-eight motion, away from metal, until the accuracy improves.
Tells how much iron, steel or a magnet nearby changes the field
Away from metal: the change is counted from the field here

Move the phone\'s top slowly over the surface, without turning it. It finds iron and steel (a nail, a pipe, a stud in a wall) a few centimeters away, and magnets farther; aluminum, copper and gold it can\'t. Zero it again when it drifts. The vibration motor has a magnet too, so the tone disturbs the reading less.
The Earth\'s own field is 25–65 µT, depending on where you are. X runs to the right of the screen, Y to its top, Z out of it.
